Good Wednesday, everybody

I found  an unsolved missing person case from 1957 right here in Arkansas

A prominent Arkansas lawyer vanished from her own home in 1957, leaving behind her car, purse, cash and an unsolved mystery that still hangs over Camden.

Maud Crawford was one of Arkansas’s early female attorneys, Camden’s first woman elected to the city council and a founder of Arkansas Girls State. On March 2, 1957, her husband returned from a movie and found the lights and television on, her car in the driveway, her purse containing $142 on a chair and the family dog undisturbed. Maud was gone.

Because a former law partner, U.S. Senator John McClellan, was investigating organized crime, authorities initially considered Mafia involvement. Later reporting raised questions about a disputed multimillion-dollar estate and possible interference with the original investigation, but none of those allegations was ever proven.

No body was found. In 1969, an Arkansas court declared that Maud had died through foul play committed by unknown persons. Nearly seventy years later, her disappearance remains one of Arkansas’s strangest unsolved mysteries.

4. Describe the music you want....mood, https://t.co/duveGhicVy

Most people think Grok Bot is just a chat window.

It's not. Each bot has its own computer, with its own browser, email inbox and desktop. When I ask it to do something, it goes off and does it.

I made a video explaining how it actually works 👇
